name: AMBANK
recent: AMMB 公布 2026 财年第二季度业绩，净利为 RM540.06 million，并宣派每股 15.0 sen 的中期股息。EPF 在近期多次减持后，持股比例降至约 17.2%。公司同时发布股息除权、登记及派发日期。
notable: 公布 2026 财年第二季度净利 RM540.06 million。
宣派 2026 财年每股 15.0 sen 单层中期股息。
EPF 近期减持后持股比例降至约 17.2%。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报减持股份。
有一则关于清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人的公告。
earnings: 最近一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 RM1,312.96 million，环比增长 3.5%，同比增长 3.3%；净利为 RM520.23 million，环比微降 0.1%，同比增长 0.8%；净利率为 39.6%，上一季为 41.0%。

recent_en: AMMB reported 2QFY2026 net profit of RM540.06 million and declared an interim dividend of 15.0 sen per share. EPF reduced its stake to about 17.2% after several disposals. The company also announced the ex-date, entitlement date and payment date for the dividend.
notable_en: Reported 2QFY2026 net profit of RM540.06 million.
Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 15.0 sen per share for FY2026.
EPF's shareholding fell to about 17.2% after recent disposals.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple notices of shareholding changes in October and November.
There is an announcement on winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,312.96 million, up 3.5% QoQ and 3.3% YoY; net income was RM520.23 million, down 0.1% QoQ and up 0.8% YoY; net margin was 39.6% versus 41.0% in the previous quarter.
